description: Concentration dropdown options for one well. 'Auto' is first and names the channel the selector picked for that well; the matching explicit channel is tagged with an arrow so the pick is visible either way.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 0 AS ord,
       'auto' AS value,
       'Auto — ' || INITCAP(COALESCE(w.concentration_feature, 'auger')) || CASE WHEN w.concentration_feature IS NULL THEN ' (fallback)' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM (SELECT 1) _one
LEFT JOIN featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 w ON w.well_name = :well_name
UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'auger',  'Auger'  || CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 x WHERE x.well_name = :well_name AND x.concentration_feature = 'auger')  THEN ' ← auto' ELSE '' END
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'target', 'Target' || CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 x WHERE x.well_name = :well_name AND x.concentration_feature = 'target') THEN ' ← auto' ELSE '' END
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'denso',  'Denso'  || CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 x WHERE x.well_name = :well_name AND x.concentration_feature = 'denso')  THEN ' ← auto' ELSE '' END
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'inline', 'Inline' || CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 x WHERE x.well_name = :well_name AND x.concentration_feature = 'inline') THEN ' ← auto' ELSE '' END
) q ORDER BY ord
